title: KRAS-G12C inhibitor AZ-47 suppresses tumor cell growth and induces apoptosis in KRASG12C-mutant non-small cell lung cancer models
key_finding: AZ-47 potently inhibits viability of KRASG12C-mutant NSCLC cell lines (IC50 4-9 nM) while sparing KRAS wild-type lines, and induces apoptosis through suppression of RAF-MEK-ERK signaling.

assays.mechanism: phospho-ERK suppression, caspase-3/7 activation, PARP cleavage
assays.statistics: two-way ANOVA with Sidak's multiple comparisons test, n=3 biological replicates
